summary: Follow-up verification pass for Now Kart Iteration 4 (2nd focused round). Confirmed both previously-reported issues are FIXED: (1) HIGH - checkout stock-validation false-positive (quantityAvailable=0 + availableForSale=true) no longer blocks checkout-prep; verified via direct API call AND full UI happy-path (Categories -> add to cart -> Cart -> Proceed to Checkout) that the address-selection screen (checkout-content) now renders instead of the checkout-issues blocker. (2) LOW - /checkout/address with no cartId now shows the ErrorState ('No cart to check out...') promptly instead of an infinite spinner, verified via direct navigation. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (100%) - all pre-existing auth/catalog/cart tests plus a fresh run, including the new auth-hardening behaviors (web-platform authorize-url rejected 400, native 200, guest 401 on /me and /addresses, garbage-token 401, refresh/logout with invalid token handled gracefully with no 500s). Frontend sanity re-check: home screen at localhost preview renders correctly with 1 root child, home-screen testID present, zero console/page errors - the persistent blank-white-page anomaly the main agent's own tooling reported was NOT reproduced in this independent verification; the prior fix (AuthContext.tsx using src/utils/storage instead of expo-secure-store) appears fully effective. Regression checks: guest browsing (home/categories/collection/search) works, wishlist add/remove + header badge sync (0->1->0) verified end-to-end including the wishlist screen list/empty-state, and all requested auth endpoint checks passed.
action_items: None outstanding from this pass. Both previously reported issues (checkout stock false-positive, /checkout/address infinite spinner) are confirmed fixed with no regressions.

Real Shopify Customer Account email-verification OAuth completion and address CRUD with a real signed-in customer remain an untestable environment boundary (native-build-only), as established in prior rounds - not a defect.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_cart_lines now correctly distinguishes (a) hard out-of-stock (availableForSale=false) from (b) genuine limited-stock overage (positive quantityAvailable < requested quantity), and no longer misflags continue-selling-when-out-of-stock variants (quantityAvailable=0, availableForSale=true) - verified against this store's real inventory data where every product has quantityAvailable=0.

checkout/address.tsx's load() now sets both isLoading=false and a descriptive error before returning when cartId is missing, replacing the prior fire-and-forget early return that left the ActivityIndicator spinning forever.

auth/service.py's refresh-token reuse detection (revoking all sessions for a user on a rotated-token replay) and single-use OAuth state (_state_cache.pop) are sound, defensive implementations; sessionToken.ts's single-flight refresh guard correctly prevents concurrent 401s from each independently rotating/invalidating the same refresh token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (auth-completion/native-only boundary excluded as expected)

seed_data_creation: None - tested against live Shopify store data (vcq88p-fj.myshopify.com) and the app's own MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes from the previous round are verified working with no regressions. Web preview renders correctly and consistently across this session - if the main agent's own screenshot tool sees blank-page anomalies again, it is likely environment/timing-specific (e.g. screenshot taken before Metro finished a rebuild) rather than a persistent app bug, since this independent Playwright pass (fresh navigations, multiple flows, ~10 script runs) never reproduced it. Auth-completion (real email verification, address CRUD as a signed-in customer) remains the only untestable boundary in this environment.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this pass found no new issues; both previously-identified root causes (stock-validation logic gap, missing error state on missing cartId) were correctly fixed at the source as described in the review request.
